diagnosis: Candidate/bad runs overrepeat actions without gaining new state, especially clicks, no-ops, and scrolling.
expected_mechanism: Detecting unchanged outcomes forces strategy changes before loops grow, improving progress and reducing wasted operations. The cost is state-comparison overhead and occasional premature switching when repetition is genuinely necessary.
policy_text: Track the outcome of each action. If the same or equivalent action produces no materially new state twice, do not repeat it unchanged; reassess the goal, inspect current evidence, and choose a different action, target, strategy, or explicit termination.

quantitative_evidence.finding: Repeated-result operations have +1,261 bad-minus-good excess (11.31% of the profile). Within this behavior, clicks contribute +639, no-ops +356, and scrolling +277.
Candidate/bad runs contain 1,485 repeated-result operations versus 224 in base/good runs: 1,261 net excess and 6.63 times as many candidate operations.
Traces reproduce repeated actions across distinct sessions and tasks, including repeated search clicks and repeated ticket-navigation clicks over many successive steps.
